node.statement: Apply the preceding facts to X=U^dagger and X=U bold-dot V. Each X has a right inverse and defect at most 40*epsilon_r. If epsilon_r>0, the root margin 600*epsilon_r<t implies 40*epsilon_r<t/15<2t; if epsilon_r=0, the defect is 0<2t because t>0. Thus the definition gives X in calU_t, and the direct polar inclusion gives X in S_delta. This establishes the claimed global membership without using pending siblings 1.1 or 1.3.
